aberdeen.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of the North East
s1loc: Aberdeen anchors live events across the North East of Scotland. P and J Live at TECA in Bucksburn is the biggest arena in the north, handling the major tours, while Aberdeen Performing Arts runs His Majesty's Theatre, the historic Music Hall and the grassroots Lemon Tree across the granite city. As an isolated city, Aberdeen draws crews from Dundee, Perth and Elgin at a distance, and its summer fills with concerts and outdoor events around the harbour and Union Street.

And the trade runs at every size here. P and J Live, the Aberdeen Performing Arts venues, festival operators and production companies field big crews and large seasonal teams and buy through procurement, while independent event crews, promoters and entertainers across Aberdeenshire want just a few branded pieces. A workwear supplier this far north has to serve the big arena and the single crew alike, which is why we run trade accounts and direct online ordering side by side.
